folds.heading: ## Current-scope reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B83)
folds.body: IR1–IR4/IR8, F1–F9, O1/O2, D1–D4 and A1–A6 retain their original typed-adapter and full-state ownership proposals. A pure canon snapshot is not a native save; a reveal coordinate is not receipt by an observer; source chapters/windows are not automatically elapsed minutes. The proposed outer one-branch profile and legacy wrapper are one future compatibility design, not prerequisites for unrelated current world/arc delivery. Existing accepted compatibility decisions and actual save owners still govern. Do not overwrite moving main from the old start-records worktree or infer current writer locks from R1–R5. The one-realm/prestige milestone and 1366-primary target are retired; current PROJECT/rule direction, desktop/laptop targets and AD36/AD42/AD43 govern new selected work. Keep branch switching, broader offline credit and ownership-aware reset distinct, without claiming their implementation or starting a new wave (AD32).

folds.heading: ## Later integration and current selected routing, 2026-11-04 (B83)
folds.body: This initial required-join map is an October 6 source snapshot; its later root-reported joins and source-definition review already qualify the original pending wording. Current selected item registration invokes registerMolItems, and book_world_mol_native exports the shared native owner’s calendar, quest projection, envelope validation and bindings. Those source observations prevent treating the initial six-leaf/line/schema layout as today’s missing interface, but do not certify every current join. Later [exploration/body/learning reconciliation](../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b60.json) preserves actual scoped Cyoria/hatch/device/expiry routes and their fixture/earned/source-test limits, without novel parity, every origin or the canonical loop. Retain exact stock/custody, active-body, source/method/fuel, observer knowledge, declared instance clock and durable-before-publication boundaries. Neither a registry import nor a source dossier certifies current rebuilt gameplay. Old writer reservations and future acceptance examples select no new implementation, migration, test rerun or source acquisition (AD32/AD36/AD42).
